'''Nattis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a specialist in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. As part of the Imperial strike team dispatched to [[The Tomb]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], Nattis and his superior [[Master Sergeant/Legends|Master Sergeant]] [[Hayg]] engaged a group of [[Esh-kha]] armed with highly advanced [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Hayg's objective was to deal with Republic forces, and so it fell to Nattis to recruit a fellow Imperial who could retrieve the dangerous technology from the Esh-kha.<ref name="Found in Translation" />
